svg.title: A directed acyclic graph sigma with edges 1 to 2, 1 to 3, 2 to 3, 2 to 5, 3 to 6 and 4 to 7, whose leaves 5, 6, 7 are boxed as L0. Removing them gives sigma_1 (edges 1 to 2, 1 to 3, 2 to 3, and vertex 4) with leaves 3 and 4 boxed as L1; then sigma_2 (edge 1 to 2) with leaf 2 boxed as L2; then sigma_3, the single vertex 1, boxed as L3.
